title: You're Taller in the Morning
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Between the bones of your spine are soft discs, full of water.
Standing all day squeezes water out, and you lose a centimetre or two.
Lying down at night, the discs soak it back up.
Astronauts in orbit stretch even more, up to three percent.
